subject: Subprocessor delegated controls & bundled SOC 2 artifacts
body:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthsentry.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: delegated controls + bundled SOC2 artifacts for procurement

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and security at HealthSentry are doing a deeper review before we move to a PO. Two asks we need to close this loop:

1) A current subprocessor roster (CSV preferred) that includes: name, service provided, country of operation, data access scope (production/dev/telemetry), and whether they are covered by Redwood's SOC 2.
2) A delegated-controls matrix that maps each subprocessor to the control families where Redwood has delegation versus retained responsibility (we need to show ownership for CC6/CC7-type controls).
3) A single bundled package (zip) of SOC 2 artifacts we can consume (system descriptions, control narratives, sample evidence filenames). It's OK if some artifacts are redacted; procurement needs the packaging to validate the attestation workflow.
4) Any carve-outs or SLA exceptions (e.g., subprocessor maintenance windows, on-call escalation tiers) and geo-residency notes (are any subprocessors restricted from EU-only data?).

Target timeline: can you get an initial bundle by Monday (Dec 21)? If you have a HubSpot or Drive link to send, that works too.

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Security Programs Manager
HealthSentry

--

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthsentry.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: delegated controls + bundled SOC2 artifacts for procurement

Monica/Jonas — FYI: HealthSentry is asking for a reasonably standard bundle but wants delegated-controls mapping and explicit geo-residency notes.

Action items:
- Monica: please assemble the subprocessor CSV and the SOC2 artifact package. Mark any artifacts that are redactions (we'll flag).
- Jonas: please pull the delegated_controls_matrix (new template we used for GovMed last quarter) and annotate any control carve-outs / escalation contacts. Note whether any subprocessors cannot accept EU-only data and propose alternates where possible.

HealthSentry asked for delivery by Mon 12/21 — I told them we'd aim for a preliminary bundle earlier if possible. Loop back here when you have the files and I'll forward the package.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

--

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthsentry.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: delegated controls + bundled SOC2 artifacts for procurement

On Fri, Dec 18, 2026 at 4:03 PM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Monica/Jonas — FYI: HealthSentry is asking for a reasonably standard bundle but wants delegated-controls mapping and explicit geo-residency notes.
>
> Action items:
> - Monica: please assemble the subprocessor CSV and the SOC2 artifact package. Mark any artifacts that are redactions (we'll flag).
> - Jonas: please pull the delegated_controls_matrix (new template we used for GovMed last quarter) and annotate any control carve-outs / escalation contacts. Note whether any subprocessors cannot accept EU-only data and propose alternates where possible.

Hi all — attaching the initial bundle. TL;DR: we can deliver a redacted SOC2 artifact package and full subprocessor roster today, and a delegated-controls matrix tomorrow with the escalation contact details.

What I'm attaching (zipped and shared link below):
- redwood_subprocessors_2026-12.csv (columns: name, service, country, data_scope, soc2_in_scope, sla_notes)
- soc2_artifact_package_v1.zip (redacted system descriptions, control narratives, sample evidence filenames; artifact index included)
- delegated_controls_matrix_draft.xlsx (first pass — missing two vendor on-call contact rows)

Notes / findings:
- One subprocessor (EdgeCacheCo) maintains EU POPs but contractually only offers US-only data isolation by default. We flagged EdgeNode EU as an available alternative (we have evaluation notes and can propose migration timeline Q1 2027 if HealthSentry needs EU residency).
- SLA carve-outs: standard maintenance windows for inference pools (2 hours/month) and scheduled model upgrade windows (non-urgent upgrades up to 4 hours) — these are listed in the CSV under sla_notes.
- Redactions: internal ticket IDs and specific sample log extracts are redacted; index entries point to where auditors can request unredacted proofs under NDA.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-healthsentry-bundle
HubSpot ticket: HS-40219

I'll finish the delegated_controls_matrix with escalation contacts first thing tomorrow and add a short readme mapping artifacts to SOC 2 criteria.

Monica Patel
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): redwood_subprocessors_2026-12.csv, soc2_artifact_package_v1.zip, delegated_controls_matrix_draft.xlsx

--

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@healthsentry.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 10:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: delegated controls + bundled SOC2 artifacts for procurement

Hi Lina — attaching the bundle we discussed and a short summary below. Monica and Jonas have pulled the initial artifacts; Monica finished the matrix this morning.

Delivered items (in Drive and attached zip):
- redwood_subprocessors_2026-12.csv (full roster + service/data_scope + SLA notes)
- delegated_controls_matrix_v1.xlsx (delegation status per control family; includes on-call and escalation owners)
- soc2_artifact_package_v1.zip (redacted artifacts index + supporting narratives)

Key callouts:
- EdgeCacheCo: currently configured for US residency only; if HealthSentry requires strict EU residency we recommend EdgeNode EU as a replacement. Proposed migration window: Q1 2027; estimated migration effort: low (storage/edge config) but will require contract amendment with EdgeNode.
- SLA carve-outs documented in CSV; maintenance windows and model-upgrade windows included with typical advance-notice times.
- If you need unredacted sample evidence we can provide via a tightly-scoped NDA (we noted which files are redacted in the artifact index).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether you want the unredacted evidence under NDA (we can send a one-page scoping addendum).
2) If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the delegated-controls matrix and artifact index — I have availability Wed 12/22 between 9–11 PT.

Link to bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-healthsentry-bundle
HubSpot: HS-40219

Thanks — happy to walk through any specific control mappings.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
